skills.name: aura-agent-orchestration
skills.description: Set up AURA (Autonomous Understanding and Responsive Agents), a privacy-first on-device AI agent that sees, listens, remembers and acts, on an Arduino VENTUNO Q or a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ-8275 (IQ8) board, and choose the smallest milestone (vision, speech, memory or agent) to build first. Does not start device services or touch hardware unless you approve.
useCases: Set up the AURA on-device agent on my IQ8 board
Which AURA milestone should I build first: vision, speech, memory or agent?
Install only the AURA vision extra and run the tests
Show my AURA configuration and tell me which optional components are missing
Should AURA reason on the board, on my PC, or in hybrid mode with a trusted host?
Prepare AURA for my Arduino VENTUNO Q without opening the camera or microphone
Record which AURA settings I observed on the device and which are still unknown
